proposedOpening.en: Christ is the first and principal offerer of Mass; the ordained priest is His minister, offering the same sacrifice to the Father.
proposedOpening.fr: Le Christ est le premier et principal offrant de la Messe ; le prêtre ordonné est son ministre, offrant le même sacrifice au Père.

records.sourcePrecisionDelta: Do not present priest as an independent principal sacrificer.

proposedOpening.en: Christ instituted the sacrifice of Mass at the institution of the Eucharist, commanding its memorial in remembrance of His Passion.
proposedOpening.fr: Le Christ a institué le sacrifice de la Messe en instituant l'Eucharistie, ordonnant son mémorial en souvenir de sa Passion.

records.sourcePrecisionDelta: Later Catechism making-present language is editorial corroboration, not verbatim Pius X.

proposedOpening.en: The Mass is offered to God alone, even when celebrated in honour of Mary or the saints.
proposedOpening.fr: La Messe est offerte à Dieu seul, même lorsqu'elle est célébrée en l'honneur de Marie ou des saints.

records.sourcePrecisionDelta: Distinguish recipient of sacrifice from saints' intercession and honour.
